raw.rationale: CPI-613 inhibits pyruvate dehydrogenase and mitochondrial metabolism, which can selectively impair cancer cells with high oxidative phosphorylation dependence, but PRISM single-agent screens typically show few lineage-selective effects at 2.5 µM; modest enrichment is most plausible in hematologic or high-OXPHOS lineages, none of which are listed, so probabilities remain near base rates with slight elevation for liver, pancreas, and upper aerodigestive due to metabolic dependencies.
